episode_row: decision records lacked state provenance, dropped second candidate

commits.subject: feat(decision): bts_daily_decision_v2 — state provenance on every final record
commits.body:
The 8/09 boundary-shadow census (Codex r4) found v1 records unusable as a
state source: 31/44 persisted no streak/saver (only MDP skips did), skip
records lost the executable second candidate, and nothing recorded which
state stream fed the decision — while production selection is contest-
anchored and the census had no way to know what decide_action consumed.

v2 persists on EVERY final record: streak, saver_available, state_source,
state_status, allow_double, contest_source_date — stamped in
orchestrator.run_and_pick from the exact DecisionStreakState that fed
select_pick (not re-read at write time, which could differ mid-day) — and
second_candidate on skips (SelectionResult already carried it; it was
dropped at capture). SelectionResult gains four default-None provenance
fields (positional constructors untouched); both skip-capture sites and
the commit chokepoint thread them through. load_decision accepts
{v1, v2} — legacy records through 8/09 stay authoritative for the #144
scoreable gate and the skip-policy shadow (regression-tested with a
hand-written v1 fixture).

Prospective effect: from the first deploy onward, every decision day
accumulates exact-state records — the untouched stream the amended
boundary-shadow registration requires for any verdict-bearing evaluation.

Suite 1901 -> 1908.
